basic_info.description: **Seller to pay 24 months of HOA fees for the buyer**  Beautiful open concept full floor flat with a center island for your friends and family to gather.  Stunning steel beam brings a contemporary feeling to this classic Edwardian TIC building.    Sub Zero refrigerator, high end appliances, and two decks create house-like living in Nob Hill. Exclusive use 3 car garage with a bonus 212 square foot flex room and 1/2 bath behind.  Close to Trader Joe's, Grace Cathedral, and Huntington Park. Welcome home! Clear Markoff Structural Report, New roof, and a Sirkin Agreement in place. Professional HOA financial management by HOM Works.
